summary.content:
Today's selection covers 77 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 12 articles published in the last 24 hours
